moments.text: Black-and-white sensor view looking down at an angle on a city: a large walled park with trees in the middle, streets and pylons around it.
After a brief black frame the view widens over the dense city and drifts across rooftops toward bare hills.
A small dark round spot appears at the left; as the view moves onto bare ridges, the sensor keeps it just left of the crosshair.
The sensor zooms in; the picture flattens to grey over rocky slopes, the dark spot hovering left of the crosshair, sometimes near the edge.
Over plain grey ground the spot looks larger, a dark disc with a light rim, wandering around the crosshair.
The sensor cycles its zoom over flat grey haze, with white and black flashes. No spot visible.
A small light round spot shows below the crosshair, then circles close to it as cloud tops pass behind.
The picture turns blue-tinted; only a faint blurry smudge left of the crosshair remains.
Back in grey, a light spot sits on the crosshair, drifts out to the left edge, then returns beside the N symbol.
The spot is gone; the picture dims and goes black several times as the sensor changes settings.
A tiny light dot enters at the right edge and the sensor swings to bring it toward the centre.

notes: No black bars; redaction boxes over HUD. No object found over the city at 0:09-0:25 (official text says one enters there); the tracked spot first shows at 0:27.
